purpose: Discuss an accident; teach 当局/死亡/異常/宣言/強制/減少/処分/戦い

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 工場で事故があったってニュース、見ました？
lines.en: Did you see the news about the factory accident?
lines.style: concerned teen opening the topic, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、当局が原因を調査しています。
lines.en: Yes, authorities are investigating the cause.
lines.style: teacher noting the official response, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 幸い、死亡者はいなかったそうです。
lines.style: relieved student sharing good news, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 機械の異常が引き金だったとか。
lines.en: A machine abnormality was reportedly the trigger.
lines.style: teen identifying the cause, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 会社は安全宣言を出し直しました。
lines.en: The company reissued a safety declaration.
lines.style: teacher reporting the corporate move, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 違反があれば、強制的な指導が入ります。
lines.en: If there are violations, compulsory guidance follows.
lines.style: student explaining the consequence, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 事故を減少させるには、点検が大事ですね。
lines.style: thoughtful teen drawing a lesson, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 古い設備は、早めに処分すべきです。
lines.en: Old equipment should be disposed of early.
lines.style: teacher offering practical advice, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 安全を守るのも、地道な戦いですね。
lines.en: Keeping things safe is a steady battle too.
lines.style: reflective student closing the thought, tone holding steady through the whole line
